name: The Trinity
overview: Scripture reveals the triune nature of God, showing the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit as distinct yet unified persons. From the plural language in Genesis 1:26 to the baptismal command in Matthew 28:19, the Bible affirms the co-existence and co-operation of the three persons in creation, redemption, and sanctification. John 1 emphasizes the divinity of the Word, who became flesh, while Matthew 3:16 and Isaiah 48:16 highlight the presence and work of the Spirit alongside the Father and the Son.
